frictions.description: The ?host=acme.menuza.test:3008 gate variant 404s regardless of flags locally because acme has no customDomain row; the contract names ?host= for the gate check.
frictions.resolution: Used ?slug=acme, which VAL-ONLINE-024 explicitly allows for local tooling; recorded both variants with flags on (VAL-ONLINE-043-gate-host-vs-slug-flags-on.txt).

frictions.description: No day in the booking horizon has zero slots, so the Sites empty-slot alternatives state cannot be reached by picking a date; exhausting one day needs ~36 seat-2 tables booked against the shared durable hold limit (10/10 min), which does not fit the serial <=60 s flag windows.
frictions.resolution: Documented as a limitation on VAL-ONLINE-046; verified the waitlist-off half through the surface and the API-level alternatives payload for a preferred-time miss instead.

frictions.description: deliverAfterCommit sends due waitlist messages immediately after the triggering write, so a notify could deliver before the flag flip took effect (the waitlist_ready race lost twice before the window opened).
frictions.resolution: Staged a held waitlist_ready row with a helper token whose features claim still said waitlist:true while the live flag was off; the row-level gate then held it for the whole off window, proving the gating.

frictions.description: An operator token minted before the master flip keeps operator access for its remaining TTL (claims-based gating); the contract expects an operator route to refuse with a valid token while the master flag is off.
frictions.resolution: Tested both token shapes: current-claims token (features.enabled=false) -> 404; stale pre-flip token -> 200 until expiry. Reported as an observation on VAL-ONLINE-028; the real mint path refuses (404), so no fresh operator token exists during the off window.

frictions.description: The App login is a two-step form (email/username -> Continue -> password) and snapshot refs expire between calls, so a single-shot fill of input[name=email]/password fails.
frictions.resolution: Followed the user-testing.md recipe with fresh snapshots per step (username -> Continue -> Password -> Sign In).

frictions.description: The website builder's preview pane showed '404 Organization not found' inside the iframe for a freshly created draft page while the editor and section list worked (cosmetic preview artifact).
frictions.resolution: Captured the section list and inspector instead; the scratch page used for the add-block check was deleted afterwards.
